senses.gloss: m. pl. (of אנטל; from which Greek ἄντλος, ἄντλον &c. and our w. ἄντλεία, antlia) baling out bilge-water, pump (with wheels and buckets).
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:9">Ruth R. to II, 19</cite> <he>גלגל אנטי׳</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>אנטל׳</he> (ed. <cite ref="A02183"><he>אנטילא</he></cite>, corr. acc.) the pumping wheel.
<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:4">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 4</cite> <he>מפני א׳ שלהן</he> on account of their baling machine (besprinkling the wheat).
